backend: offline committed resources only; no network, no GPU
distinct_from: SLM-306 (docs/design/slm306-locked-manifest-digest-verification.md) built the verify_locked_manifest_digest/load_locked_manifest_payload primitive and threaded locked_manifest_path through the library functions with a None default everywhere, including the real promotion entrypoints. SLM-430 wires an explicit, default-off opt-in into the three real entrypoints SLM-306 flagged as a follow-up (scripts/resume_climb.py, scripts/run_scaling_ladder.py, ModelBuildConfig.register_promoted via train_loop.py) so the check is reachable at all, without flipping any existing default.

canonical_manifest.note: recomputed via load_locked_manifest_payload(canonical_manifest_path()); matches the digest SLM-306 recorded, confirming the committed manifest is still untampered

reproduction.method: each test monkeypatches slm_training.harnesses.experiments.promotion.load_campaign_governance to capture its kwargs and raise a sentinel exception, asserting locked_manifest_path before any real training/RL/ladder work executes

unrelated_preexisting_failure.note: fails identically with this change stashed out (git stash); a preexisting grammar_ltr_primary regression unrelated to SLM-430

honesty.scope: governance/gate CLI-wiring audit only -- no model quality, promotion, or training result is claimed here
honesty.backward_compatibility: verify_locked_manifest_digest / --verify-locked-manifest-digest default to False/absent everywhere; every existing caller, script invocation, and test that never set them keeps its prior (self-consistency-only) behavior unchanged.
honesty.still_open: Flipping the default to always supply canonical_manifest_path() (rather than requiring the flag) remains open, exactly as SLM-306 scoped it, pending a live end-to-end promotion run to validate against -- not available in this GPU-less sandbox.
